answer_1.quote: FollowBench consists of 820 meticulously curated instructions from over 50 NLP tasks, including both closed-and open-ended questions.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include text responses that must adhere to fine-grained constraints such as content, situation, style, format, and example patterns, including structured outputs like tables, JSON, and formatted text.

answer_2.quote: We use exact match as the evaluation metric.

answer_3.quote: we propose to develop a model-based approach by using strong LLMs as judges.
methods: evolution process of instructions in prompt
criteria: identification of newly added constraints at each level

answer_4.quote: Two annotators independently evaluate: (1) the appropriateness of the instruction for its designated constraint category, and (2) the validity of the added constraint within the instruction.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated the appropriateness of the instruction for its constraint category and the validity of the added constraint. For evaluation of model outputs, three expert-level human labelers assessed whether the response satisfies all constraints, using majority voting.
criteria: satisfaction of all constraints in the instruction
